categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies `src/streams.h` to redesign `BufferedWriter` error handling, preventing exceptions from escaping during destruction.
categories.rationale: Fixes an abrupt `std::terminate` crash in `BufferedWriter` by removing implicit throwing flushes from destructors and providing safe `flush()` and `discard()` methods. Author notes this regression was introduced in #31551, causing crashes when disk writes fail rather than graceful unwinding.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Modifies `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` to explicitly flush block and undo streams and handle write exceptions.
categories.rationale: Ensures failed block and undo file writes trigger a clean node shutdown and diagnostic log rather than an immediate process termination. Reviewer ryanofsky confirms turning `std::terminate` on failed block writes into normal error handling is a clear improvement for block storage stability.
